  ?pt brick:pointInLocation ?zone .
  ?pt ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?zone brick:hasName ?zone_name .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://example.org/ref#>
SELECT ?pt ?pt_class ?zone ?tsid (SAMPLE(?n) as ?n) WHERE {
  ?pt brick:hasPropertyType ?cls .
  ?zone brick:hasName ?n .
  ?pt ?rel ?zone .
}
GROUP BY ?pt ?cls ?zone
